rules: Use browser defaults for User-Agent, Referer and caching; no restrictive no-referrer policy
No bulk tile downloading, background prefetch, offline archive or automated pan/zoom scraping
Keep provider URL configurable; OSM tiles are best-effort and have no SLA
ui: Use each record’s recommended_zoom on selection, while leaving manual zoom available
Expose location.precision and location.location_note beside the point
Use hollow/halo markers for approximate_locality and approximate_planning_area; do not imply a radius is measured accuracy
Overlapping Singapore points intentionally share a campus reference; use a cluster/list or spiderfy interaction, never alter their saved coordinates
Keep road labels readable; avoid CSS inversion that alters map-label contrast
No invented cadastral polygon; footprint remains null until an appropriate published boundary is verified
map_recommendation.geocoding_note: Coordinates are stored evidence, not live browser geocoding. The research used a small cached, single-thread Nominatim run below 1 request/second. Do not add public Nominatim autocomplete or periodic bulk geocoding; https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/

metadata_patch.map_policy: Publicly documented campus, address or project-area points where supported; explicitly labeled locality markers otherwise.

limitations: No coordinate establishes real-time operating status, capacity, GPU deployment or a product-to-fab allocation.
A source-provided coordinate may be an address or project reference rather than a campus centroid.
Associated-campus points deliberately distinguish the known campus from an unresolved new project building.
OpenStreetMap-derived coordinates require ODbL attribution; source map status is never adopted as production-status evidence.
footprint_policy: All footprint geometries remain null. Published planning maps are source links, not digitized cadastral claims.
integration: Merge sites by site_id, replacing location only. Upsert sources by id. Update metadata.map_policy and replace any old rule claiming that all coordinates are city-level. Keep all existing non-location site data.
